newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates jump on special OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates jump on special OMO.

text.p: Pakistani money rates jumped after the State (central) Bank of Pakistan picked up 5.2 billion rupees in a special open market operation (OMO) and closed higher, dealers said.
They said rates were likely to open higher on Monday due to borrowing pressure in the market.
The rate opened at 11 percent and shot to 17 percent at the close. Banks utilised the SBP discounting facility due to a shortage of funds after the OMO.
